headline: Half-Year Reports for Power, Oil, Sugar and Water Are Out! Taipower Loses NT$25.7 Billion, the Worst; CPC Earns NT$13.3 Billion Temporarily on 'Timing Gap' - Liberty Finance
summary: Taipower and Taiwan Water posted half-year losses, with Taipower's loss at NT$25.7 billion due to a fuel shock. CPC still earned over NT$10 billion pre-tax as costs were not fully reflected.
why: Taipower is Taiwan's state-owned power utility, and its finances affect electricity pricing and public budgets, while CPC is the state-run oil refiner and retailer.
